definition{
  name: lineEnd,
  parameters: [s : Bytes, i : Nat, fuel : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => i
    | Nat.succ rest => (if ((Foundation.Tar::byteOr s i) =? 10) then i else (lineEnd s (i + 1) rest))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{
  name: sliceOr,
  parameters: [s : Bytes, start : Nat, count : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Foundation.Bytes::sliceBytes s start count)
    | Option.none => 0x
    | Option.some b => b)
}

definition{
  name: wordEnd,
  parameters: [s : Bytes, i : Nat, stop : Nat, fuel : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => i
    | Nat.succ rest => (if (stop <? (i + 1)) then stop else (if ((Foundation.Tar::byteOr s i) =? 32) then i else (wordEnd s (i + 1) stop rest)))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}
